sources.entry: Lucid - Live 4K wallpapers with moving space, nature and ocean loops on every display, plus Apple Aerials. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/jedbrnth-eng/lucid-live-wallpaper) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Lucid
summary.one_liner: Lucid is a free, open-source native macOS app that plays moving 4K space, nature, ocean and city wallpapers behind your desktop icons on every display.
use_cases: Replace a static Mac desktop picture with a moving 4K scene
Show different live wallpapers on each monitor
Switch wallpaper automatically between day and night
Use your own videos or photos as a desktop background
Rotate wallpapers on a timer or schedule
Use NASA and ESA space footage as desktop backgrounds
summary.what_it_does: Lucid places a borderless, muted video window at desktop level on each display, looping a selected 4K scene beneath the desktop icons. It ships with about 594 curated moving wallpapers from ESA/Webb, ESA/Hubble, ESO, NASA and Wikimedia Commons, plus Apple Aerials, which download on demand when not already on the Mac. Users can add their own videos, photos or folders, choose fill, fit or stretch, and set playback speed. Optional features include audio-reactive effects driven by system sound, Day & Night switching at sunrise and sunset, and playlists on a schedule. Playback pauses behind full-screen apps, on screen lock, in Low Power Mode, below a chosen battery level and when the Mac runs hot.
notable: Audio-reactive wallpapers that respond to system sound output, not the microphone
Smart pausing behind full-screen apps, on sleep/lock, and in Low Power Mode
No account, analytics or telemetry; built natively in Swift with no third-party dependencies
Open source under GPL-3.0 with credits and license shown per item
caveats: Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 14 Sonoma or later
Not notarized by Apple yet, so the browser download must be opened via System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway
WebM and MKV files are converted only when ffmpeg is installed
Apple Aerials not already on the Mac download from Apple when selected
